fact: The donor is a Windows .NET/WPF automation application; the app config targets .NET Framework 4.5.
The production executable contains a .themida marker/section; method-body reverse should prefer the alternate managed build and PDB before broad unpacking.
Auto_ThanLong_obfusca.exe exposes 57 TypeDefs, 1070 MethodDefs and 429 Fields in CLR metadata; many bodies are protected/non-standard.
The Debug PDB yields 783 unique identifier-like symbols, preserving many original feature/state/method names.
The main managed assembly statically references KAutoHelper AutoControl position click, keyboard text/key, drag, window handle/text APIs; CaptureWindow/CropImage; and ImageScanOpenCV FindOutPoint(s).

Among KAutoHelper.ADBHelper members, the main assembly statically references Delay but not Tap, Swipe, ScreenShoot or ConnectNox. Bundled ADB control capability therefore does not by itself prove the donor gameplay loop uses ADB input.
The main assembly directly references TesseractEngine constructor/SetVariable/Process and Page.GetText, proving an active OCR integration surface.
Main metadata includes NoxMultiIni pid/vmpid/Ports and Nox title/ADB-port mapping methods; the main assembly also references ProcessHelper.GetNetStatPorts and Port pid/port_number getters.
DeviceInfo exposes QuestThread and CheckQuestThread plus IsRuningQuest; main external refs include Thread Start/Sleep/Abort/Suspend/Resume, consistent with per-device worker orchestration.
The snapshot contains 1393 PNG image assets; 1180 are byte-unique, with 178 exact duplicate groups (213 redundant copies).
The bundle contains file-backed runtime/config state under luufile plus sensitive plaintext-looking key/account/code files; DATA-333 indexes schema/hash only and excludes their values.
